# Vishrea Studio

> Independent luxury womenswear boutique & atelier based in Electronic City Phase 2, Bengaluru, India. Creator of one-of-one silhouettes, curated designer co-ords, tailored wide leg pants, and the Walkin Wardrobe styling membership.

Vishrea Studio specializes in limited-run, one-of-one womenswear silhouettes, bespoke fashion tailoring, and private wardrobe curation. Headquartered in Electronic City Phase 2, Bengaluru, the studio operates both a physical walk-in atelier and a nationwide direct-to-consumer digital storefront.

## Core Offerings & Specializations
- **One-of-One Silhouettes**: Limited-edition statement pieces where each silhouette is curated or crafted with unique cuts, fabrics, and drape.
- **Walkin Wardrobe Membership**: Curated private shopping tier with exclusive monthly wardrobe drops, early access, styling consultations, and store credits (₹1,799/month).
- **Personal Colour & Style Analysis**: Interactive and in-studio palette recommendations (Cool, Warm, Neutral, Olive) paired with curated apparel.
- **Custom Alterations & Hem Tailoring**: Bespoke sizing adjustments available upon request for orders and in-studio consultations.
